description.narrative: The rice sector accounted for nearly 60% of Thailand’s agricultural emissions. The Sustainable Rice Platform, co-convened by UNEP and the International Rice Research Institute, promoted resource efficiency and sustainability in trade flows, supply chains, and production and consumption. The project reached 450,000 beneficiaries in Thailand and worked with rice farmers, their associations, and other service providers to adopt advanced farming practices and develop supporting financial incentive schemes. It facilitated national replicability and ASEAN-wide scalability. Through innovative financial incentives, private sector investment reached EUR 5.4M, while the government earmarked EUR 9M for agricultural mitigation-related activities. These changes reduced direct emissions by 1.8 Mt CO2e cumulatively over the 5-year lifespan of the project.
